content:
Predefined reports generated by the firewall do not contain XFF values. However, the firewall has
built-in report templates that include XFF information. To view XFF IP addresses in reports, follow
the steps to generate reports with the built-in templates.
STEP 1 |
Log in to your firewall.
STEP 2 |
Select Monitor > Manage Custom Reports > Add.
STEP 3 |
Click Load Template.

STEP 4 |
Enter XFF into the search bar and click the search button to locate the built-in XFF report
templates.
STEP 5 |
Click Load.
STEP 6 |
Configure your custom report. Click Time Frame, Sort By, and Group By to display the XFF
information in the manner best suited to your needs.
STEP 7 |
(Optional) Click Run Now to generate your report on demand instead of, or in addition to, a
Scheduled Time.
